techCategories.name: Tiered
techCategories.description: General configuration techs that have tiered proficiencies.

note: Ability to kill or dodge enemies with a similar level of precision as required in some of the later dungeons in the vanilla game.
This expects the ability to use weapons such as the bow or rods to deal damage, or even the Hammer or Bombs on slower enemies.
This also expects the ability to use the Hookshot or Boomerang to stun enemies.
Ability to kill or dodge enemies with precision while minimizing resouce usage.
This expects the ability to use alternate weapons such as the canes to kill enemies.
Expects refined and practiced movement to dodge enemies.
Expects high-precision dodging and full-room enemy manipulations to avoid damage.
Ability to fight bosses with a similar level of difficulty as some of the later bosses in the vanilla game.
This expects the ability to use weapons such as the bow or rods on a variety of bosses.
Ability to fight bosses while efficiently dodging and dealing attacks with accuracy to avoid wasting resources.
This expects the ability to use alternate weapons such as the canes, Hammer, and Bombs on a variety of bosses.
Expects a refined and practiced boss fight with few or no hits taken or wasted ammo or magic.
Expects high-precision kills that only come with practicing bosses with unusual weapons.
Fights that should be theoretically possible but haven't been tested or precisely placed in the proper difficulty tier.
Ability to traverse simple dark rooms without the Lamp.
Expects simple room traversal with plenty of enemy damage leniency.
This is typically only included for strats with a good movement indicator, like a sword, boomerang, etc.
Ability to traverse dark rooms without the Lamp.
Expects precise traversal of simple rooms or traversal of moderately difficult rooms with enemy damage leniency.
This also includes the ability to know where torches in a room are which can be lit with the Fire Rod.
Depending on the complexity of the room, this may expect traversal with creative movement indicators, like the Red Cane.
Expects the traversal of complex routes through dark rooms without the Lamp while minimizing enemy damage.
This also expects blindly killing enemies which can move but drop a required key.
It is important to know the layout of the room and where enemies will spawn,
where pots and chests are and scripted movements for how to get into position to pick them up,
and how to recover when an enemy unpredictably changes Link's positioning.
Expects fully scripted and practiced movement through many consecutive complex dark rooms in a row without the Lamp.

techs.name: canBonkBoost
note: Dashing into an object, like a pot or wall, to boost backwards over a pit.
It is typically best to begin dashing while not facing the object, then rotate towards the object before the dash activates.
